title: types: PageNodeSchema.kind still declares 'jsx', which spec retired (objectstack#23638), so Spec Main Shape Gate is red on main and every PR (TS2430, layout.ts:1516)
body:
Filing gate ① · a measured red on `main` · objectui `domain:ui` seat 2 · `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`. ⛔ Not a claim; for triage to grade and route.

## The red

`Spec Main Shape Gate` is red on `main` (its run at 2026-10-15T10:02Z) and on every PR since, compiled against objectstack `7cb33cfefef9`. It reports 2 diagnostics in 1 file. Both are `TS2430` at `packages/types/src/layout.ts:1516`: "Interface 'PageNodeSchema' incorrectly extends interface 'Omit<…SpecPage…>'". Read from job `116367882940` (PR #12467's run, the same verdict as `main`'s).

## The shape that moved

objectstack-ai/objectstack#23638 (`c5dd7fce`, "feat(spec)!: retire the page kind jsx …"), an ancestor of `7cb33cf`, narrows the spec's `Page.kind` from `['full', 'slotted', 'html', 'react', 'jsx']` to `['full', 'slotted', 'html', 'react']`. `jsx` is now a retired value with a rename guidance ("Use `kind: 'html'`"), and `COMPILED_PAGE_KINDS` becomes `['html']`.

objectui still declares the old value:
- `packages/types/src/layout.ts:1795`: `kind?: 'full' | 'slotted' | 'html' | 'jsx' | 'react';` on `PageNodeSchema`, which `extends … Omit<SpecPage, …>`. A wider `kind` no longer extends the spec's.
- `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/page.tsx` also names `'jsx'` as a page kind.

## Ask

- objectui follows the spec's retirement: drop `'jsx'` from `PageNodeSchema.kind` and from the renderer's kind handling. The spec's own guidance is the migration: a `jsx` page is an `html` page.
- Do it under the creation-stage rule: an immediate retirement, with no `jsx` alias kept on the consumer side.
- Timing: the pinned published `@objectstack/spec` may still carry `jsx`. Removing the literal is compatible with both, because a narrower `kind` extends either shape. Triage to confirm against the pin.

## Effect today

The gate is advisory on PRs and does not run on `merge_group` (`.github/workflows/spec-main-shape-gate.yml` header), so the queue is not blocked. The workflow names a red on `main` a MAIN-RED for the `domain:devx` lane, and every objectui PR shows it red until this lands.

Dedupe: search over objectui issues for `PageNodeSchema` (open) and `7cb33cf` → 0. objectstack open issues for `PageNodeSchema` → 0.
